{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float, handling thousands separators
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for missing values
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check the distribution of customer_segment and channel
print('\nChannel distribution:')
print(sales_df['channel'].value_counts())

print('\nCustomer segment distribution:')
print(sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check for refunded orders
print('\nStatus distribution:')
print(sales_df['status'].value_counts())

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print('\nCustomer age -1 count:')
print(sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] == -1]['customer_age'].count())"}
